description: Visual Git history with branch actions, repository workflows, and devcontainer support.
config.autoCenterCommitDetailsView: When a commit's details panel opens, scroll the graph so that the panel is centred vertically. When this is off, scroll only as far as needed to show it.
config.branchHoverPreview: Highlight the commits of a branch or tag while the pointer rests on its label in the graph, or on its row in the Branches pane, more lightly than Focus this branch does. The highlight ends when the pointer moves away, and on Escape, scrolling or any click.
config.commitHoverCards: Show a card with a commit's full message, author, date, IDs and change counts when the pointer rests on its message in the graph, or when its row has had the keyboard for a moment. The commit details hold the same information.
config.conflictForecast: Which branches the graph checks for merge conflicts with the checked-out branch. Git tries each merge in memory, without touching the work tree, the index or any ref; it needs Git 2.38 or later.
config.conflictForecast.localAndRemote: Check local branches, and remote branches with commits from the last 30 days, so that a teammate's branch that would conflict with yours is marked before either of you opens a pull request
config.dateFormat: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of the graph.
config.dateFormat.dateTime: Show the day and a 24-hour time (for example: Mar 15, 2024 14:30)
config.dateFormat.dateOnly: Show the day only (for example: Mar 15, 2024)
config.dateFormat.relative: Show how long ago each commit was made (for example: 5 minutes ago); the tooltip keeps the exact day and time
config.dateSeparators: Draw a faint line in the graph where one day's commits end and the previous day's begin, and, while the graph is scrolled, show the day of the topmost commit in a small label near the top. Days follow the date type setting, in your local time zone.
config.dateType: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Branchwise.
config.dateType.authorDate: Show each commit's author date, when its changes were first recorded, in the date column and the details panel
config.dateType.commitDate: Show each commit's committer date instead, when the commit itself was last made; rebasing, amending or cherry-picking a commit changes it
config.dragAndDrop: Let commits and branches be dragged in the graph and the Branches pane: drop a commit on the checked-out branch to cherry-pick it, or a branch on another to merge or rebase. Every drop asks for confirmation first, and every action stays in the menus.
config.fetchAvatars: No effect. Earlier versions fetched commit author avatars; that feature has been removed.
config.fetchAvatars.deprecation: Deprecated since version 0.6.0. This setting has no effect and may be removed in a later release.
config.graphColours: The colours of the graph's lanes, used in this order and repeated from the start when they run out. While this is not set, the graph uses the theme colours branchwise.graphLane1 to branchwise.graphLane12, which have the same 12 colours by default.
config.graphColours.item: A lane colour, written as #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(r, g, b) or rgba(r, g, b)
config.graphStyle: How the graph draws the lines that join commits.
config.graphStyle.rounded: Draw lines that change lanes as smooth curves
config.graphStyle.angular: Draw lines that change lanes as straight, angled segments
config.initialLoadCommits: The number of commits loaded when the graph first shows a repository or a branch.
config.issueLinks: Link references such as Jira or Linear issue keys in commit messages, in addition to the GitHub and GitLab links. Each entry has a regular expression pattern and an http: or https: url, in which $0 stands for the whole match and $1 to $9 for its groups, as in { "pattern": "\\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\\d+\\b", "url": "https://jira.example.com/browse/$0" }. Invalid entries are skipped and reported in the Branchwise output.
config.issueLinks.pattern: A JavaScript regular expression of at most 200 characters that cannot match empty text
config.issueLinks.url: The link's http: or https: address; $0 is the whole match and $1 to $9 are its groups
config.loadMoreCommits: The number of further commits loaded each time the Load Older Commits button is pressed. The button appears below the last commit only while the repository has more commits.
config.markAppliedCommits: When a branch is focused or the graph shows one branch, mark its commits whose change the checked-out branch already has, as after a cherry-pick or a rebase, by comparing patch IDs. Nothing is compared for a branch with more than 2,000 commits the checked-out branch lacks.
config.maxDepthOfRepoSearch: How many levels of subfolders below each workspace folder are searched for Git repositories. With 0, only the workspace folders themselves are checked (a folder inside a repository finds that repository). Initialized submodules of the repositories found are always listed.
config.nestedRepoSearchDepth: How many levels of subfolders inside each repository found are searched for repositories cloned there, which the Workspace pane lists under it. Hidden folders and node_modules are skipped. With 0, repositories inside other repositories are only found as submodules.
config.overviewMarkers: Show a narrow strip along the right edge of the graph that marks HEAD, branches and tags, the selection, the open commit and unpushed commits across the whole loaded history, with a band for the rows on screen. Click or drag on it to scroll there.
config.showChangesColumn: Add a Changes column to the graph with the lines each commit added and deleted, such as +12 −3, and the number of files in its tooltip. The counts are read for the rows in sight as you scroll.
config.showCurrentBranchByDefault: Show the current branch by default when Branchwise is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
config.showNearestBranch: After the message of a commit that has no branch label of its own, show the nearest branch that contains it in faint text, such as "on main". It is worked out from the loaded rows, without asking Git anything more.
config.showSignatures: Mark signed commits in the graph. Finding them reads each loaded commit once more, so turning this off makes loading slightly faster in large repositories. A commit's signature is still checked when its details are opened.
config.showUncommittedChanges: Show a row at the top of the graph for uncommitted changes. Turning this off skips the scan of the working tree, which makes loading faster in large repositories.
config.showWorktrees: Mark the commits that your other worktrees have checked out, with a dot on those that have uncommitted changes. Finding the dots runs a quick status check in up to 20 worktrees; turning this off skips it.
config.singleKeyShortcuts: Let single keys act on the focused commit row of the graph, such as B for Create Branch or Y to copy the short commit ID. Press ? in the graph for the full list. Turn this off if you use a screen reader or an extension that sends single keys of its own.
config.tabIconColourTheme: Specifies the colour theme of the icon displayed on the Branchwise tab.
config.tabIconColourTheme.colour: Show the icon in colour, which suits most Visual Studio Code colour themes
config.tabIconColourTheme.grey: Show a grey icon which suits Visual Studio Code colour themes that are predominantly grayscale
command.goTo: Go to Branch, Tag or Commit…
walkthrough.title: Get started with Branchwise
walkthrough.description: Open the graph, read it, act on commits and branches, and recover from mistakes.
walkthrough.openGraph.title: Open the graph
walkthrough.openGraph.description:
Click the Branchwise button in the Source Control view or the status bar, or run the command.
[Open Branchwise](command:branchwise.view)
walkthrough.readGraph.title: Read the graph
walkthrough.readGraph.description: Each row is a commit. Labels show branches, tags and remotes, the checked-out branch is bold, and uncommitted changes sit on top.
walkthrough.actOnCommit.title: Act on a commit
walkthrough.actOnCommit.description: Right-click a commit or click its ⋯ button for checkout, cherry-pick, revert, tag, branch and more. Every change asks for confirmation first.
walkthrough.branchesPane.title: Use the Branches pane
walkthrough.branchesPane.description:
Browse branches, remotes, tags and stashes beside the graph, with checkout, fetch and apply one click away.
[Show the Branches pane](command:branchwise.showBranches)
walkthrough.focusAndRemotes.title: Focus a branch and hide remotes
walkthrough.focusAndRemotes.description:
Highlight one branch's history without hiding the others, and keep a noisy remote's branches out of the graph.
[Show the Branches pane](command:branchwise.showBranches)
walkthrough.recover.title: Recover from a mistake
walkthrough.recover.description:
The status strip offers Continue and Abort during merges and rebases, Git Activity keeps every error, and Recover lost commits finds old branch positions.
[Open the documentation](command:branchwise.openDocumentation)
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Branchwise runs Git on local files, which a virtual workspace does not have.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Branchwise runs Git, which can start programs that the repository's configuration names.
colors.graphLane1: Colour of lane 1 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane2: Colour of lane 2 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane3: Colour of lane 3 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane4: Colour of lane 4 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane5: Colour of lane 5 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane6: Colour of lane 6 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane7: Colour of lane 7 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane8: Colour of lane 8 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane9: Colour of lane 9 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane10: Colour of lane 10 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane11: Colour of lane 11 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.graphLane12: Colour of lane 12 of the Branchwise graph, used while the branchwise.graphColours setting is not set.
colors.unpushed: Dot before a commit in the Branchwise graph that no remote branch has yet.
colors.conflict: Mark on a branch label in the Branchwise graph when merging the branch into the checked-out branch would conflict.
